in_sanskrit.name: देवयानी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The One who is the Goddess of the Gods.

in_hindi.name: देवयानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह किसी देवों की देवी है। (She is the goddess of the gods.)

in_tamil.name: தேவயானி
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவத்தின் அருத்திர்மல்லி. (She is the goddess of the gods.)

in_telugu.name: దేవయాణి
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేవపడేయోళోళు దేశి. (She is the goddess of the gods.)

in_marathi.name: Devayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devayani is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Yani’ meaning mother or youthful. In Hindu mythology, Devayani is the name of a celestial woman and the mother of the god Indra. She is also known as the goddess of the gods and is revered for her beauty, grace, and strength.
